data.body: PASS-1 G7 leaf-containment review (code-review-threshold scenario): parent contract consulted. Finding (divergent_implementation / contradicts_reality): the leaf adds a `security`-criterion-to-blocking deliverable that the parent's plan does not contain and explicitly leaves to a sibling — a leaf stepping outside the parent's contract. Realign by narrowing the leaf to the parent's derive-threshold-and-commit-artifact scope, or update the parent to own the security flip (which re-stales its plan-review attestation).
